Subject: Preflight: agenda slate, deck allocation & preread deadlines for Acme exec workshop

Team / Sara —

First pass of logistics and content ask for the Acme executive workshop (May 3, SF office). Attached: draft_agenda_v1.pdf and a draft deck_ownership_matrix.xlsx. High-level asks below so we can lock the run of show by end of next week.

Top objectives:
- Align executive priorities (strategy, product roadmap, cost/ops)
- Get consensus on rollout criteria and next 90-day commitments

Immediate asks (please respond in-thread):
1) Deck ownership: take one primary + one backup for each slot in the attached matrix. Marcus, can you own the Platform & Ops slot?
2) Preread: we want a 1-page executive preread per session. Deadline: Apr 22 COB. I'll attach a template (acme_preread_template.docx).
3) Headcount & travel liaisons: Sara, confirm final attendee list by Apr 20. TravelOps (cc'd) — hold tentative rooms and a single group dinner on May 3.
4) AV & tech: Neha, please confirm mic/laptop adapters and run a quick A/V dry run with Acme 48 hours before.

Notes: we'll do a 20-minute opening by Acme execs, then 4x30-minute sessions with 10-minute breakouts. I flagged two slots as "choice" where we may swap deeper demos vs. case studies depending on Acme's ask.

Links:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeF-acme-workshop
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ACME-2026-WKSP

Thanks — please add your initials in the matrix and call out any conflicts.

—
Soojin Lee
Head of Customer Programs | Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0128
